name: Satio

images.credit: John.Karakatsanis, CC BY-SA 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Sony Ericsson G900, Sony Ericsson P1, Sony Ericsson C905

Network.Technology: GSM GPRS/EDGE 850/900/1800/1900, UMTS HSDPA 900/2100 (Satio), GSM GPRS/EDGE 850/900/1800/1900, UMTS HSPA 850/1900/2100 (Satio(a))

Platform.CPU: ARM Cortex-A8 600 MHz processor; 3D Graphics HW Accelerator

Memory.RAM: 256 MB RAM and 128 MB ROM (Internal storage)
Memory.Card slot: microSDHC up to 32 GB, 8 GB included

Display.Display: TFT touchscreen, 16M colours 3.5 in, 360 x 640 pixels

Cameras.Rear camera: 12.1 MP, 4000 x 3000 pixels, auto-focus, xenon flash, video LED flash

Battery.Charging: Fast port (proprietary) up to 5W (standard charging speed)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g, DLNA), A-GPS, Bluetooth (v2.0 with A2DP)
